svg.title: Annex A8 · Publication, deployment and archive
svg.desc: Writing and validating data/, browser checks, artifacts, deployment and verification, and the archive job that only adds to data-archive.
svg.text: Annex A8 · Publication, deployment and archive

How a run turns what was validated into the live site without ever leaving it half done: the publication is written aside and replaces the previous one at once, tested in Chromium, deployed to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and
the live site is checked to serve it. The original responses are kept forever in data-archive.
Details these boxes of the full diagram: Publication write and validation, Published files (data/), Deploy and verification, archive job, data-archive branch.
up to 15 min · DEPLOY_TARGET picks the target
only on main and after a successful build

g.title: 1. Write to a separate folder → data/ files: files with one publicationId.
2. data/ files → Validate: temporary folder.
3. Validate → Swap at once: all consistent. If validation fails, the run stops before the swap.
4. Write to a separate folder → Original responses: every response.
5. Swap at once → Adapt to the address: public/.
6. Adapt to the address → Chromium checks: built site.
7. Chromium checks → Run artifacts: if it passes. A failing check stops the deployment: the previous publication stays online.
8. Original responses → Run artifacts: raw-sources.
9. Run artifacts → GitHub Pages (default): github-pages.
10. Run artifacts → Cloudflare Pages: site.
11. GitHub Pages (default) → Live site (SITE_URL): publishes.
12. Cloudflare Pages → Live site (SITE_URL): publishes.
13. Live site (SITE_URL) → Verify the live site: serving the new publication?.
14. Run artifacts → Download raw-sources: raw-sources.
15. Download raw-sources → Drop duplicates and truncated files: today's responses.
16. Drop duplicates and truncated files → Commit to data-archive: only what is new.
17. Download raw-sources → Merge the news history: items and history.
18. Merge the news history → Commit to data-archive: merged history.
Write to a separate folder. Every JSON and CSV carries the same publicationId and generatedAt; what could not be renewed is kept from the previous publication, with the new identifier.

g.title: Adapt to the address. prepare_site writes SITE_URL into canonical, sitemap and robots.txt. On Cloudflare, --hide-repo removes links to the repository and fails if any remain. Technology: tools.prepare_site.

Chromium checks. pytest -m browser against the built site: views, accessibility and data. WebKit and Firefox are tested in ci.yml so they never hold back official data. Technology: Playwright, pytest.
g.text: pytest -m browser against the built site:
views, accessibility and data. WebKit and
Firefox are tested in ci.yml so they never hold

g.title: Run artifacts. run-report (always), raw-sources (7 days) and the site: github-pages or “site” for Cloudflare (3 days). Technology: upload-artifact.
GitHub Pages (default). actions/deploy-pages publishes the artifact at https://pillb.github.io/observatorio-enso-peru/. Technology: deploy-pages.

Cloudflare Pages. tools.cloudflare_pages creates the project if missing and wrangler uploads the site with functions/ (consoles) to the production branch, without linking the repository. Technology: wrangler, Pages Functions.

a.title: Annex A9: The site in the browser

g.title: Verify the live site. tools.verify_live reads dashboard.json without cache every 20 s until it sees the new publicationId; after 10 min the run fails. Technology: httpx.
g.text: cache every 20 s until it sees the new
publicationId; after 10 min the run fails.

g.title: Download raw-sources. Only the file list and sources/news of data-archive (partial, sparse clone): the branch grows every day. Technology: git sparse-checkout.

g.title: Drop duplicates and truncated files. A response with the same sha256 and source is not added again; one that does not match its sha256 arrived truncated and is dropped.
g.text: A response with the same sha256 and source
is not added again; one that does not match
its sha256 arrived truncated and is dropped.

g.title: Merge the news history. merge_history.py merges items.jsonl.gz into the copy: it never loses items even if the run published an incomplete history. Technology: Python.
g.text: the copy: it never loses items even if the run

a.title: Annex A6: News and alerts: reading, filtering, history and place

g.title: Commit to data-archive. Permanent corpus by source, date and sha256. A commit that deletes files is refused; the push is tried 3 times. only grows. Technology: git.
g.text: Permanent corpus by source, date and
sha256. A commit that deletes files is
refused; the push is tried 3 times.

svg.text: Steps and connections: what travels along each line, when and why
Write to a separate folder → data/ files
If validation fails, the run stops before the swap.
Write to a separate folder → Original responses
Swap at once → Adapt to the address
Adapt to the address → Chromium checks
A failing check stops the deployment: the previous publication stays online.
Live site (SITE_URL) → Verify the live site
Download raw-sources → Drop duplicates and truncated files
Drop duplicates and truncated files → Commit to data-archive
Download raw-sources → Merge the news history
Merge the news history → Commit to data-archive
If something fails: what happens and which fallback takes over
Nothing is replaced: the site keeps serving the previous publication and
the incidents job opens an issue.
Nothing is deployed; the last good version stays online and the run is
The live site does not show the publication within 10 min
The run fails and opens “The daily update failed”; the 6 h watchdog looks
archive warns and leaves data-archive untouched; the day's items stay in
the publication and go in tomorrow.
It is retried 3 times with a wait; if it still fails, the run fails and alerts.
